script.title: Kiyomizu-dera: Temple on the Hillside Stage
script.description: A Japanese Buddhist temple after Kiyomizu-dera: the main hall juts out on a forest of timber stilts, a vermilion three-storey pagoda crowns the hill, the Otowa waterfall spills into a pool, and a red Niomon gate with a hanging lantern guards the stone stairs.
